name: Edible Cookie Dough
ingredients:
2 cups flour
2 tbsp milk powder
Pinch of salt
1 cup brown sugar
1/4 white sugar
2 sticks butter
Vanilla extract
2 tbsp milk
Chocolate chips
instructions:
Toast flour on the stove until it becomes a little darker and has a nutty smell.
Take the flour off of the heat, and add milk powder / salt.
In a mixing bowl add brown sugar, white sugar, and butter. Whisk for about a minute, and add vanilla extract.
While mixing, add in flour and milk powder.
Slowly pour in the liquid milk.
Finish with chocolate chips.
